postBody.Query: DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment | where DeviceId in ({{objects.map(o => {return `"${o.deviceid}"`}).join(",")}}) | join kind=leftouter (DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessmentKB) on ConfigurationId | project DeviceId, DeviceName, Timestamp, ConfigurationId, ConfigurationName, ConfigurationCategory, ConfigurationSubcategory, ConfigurationImpact, RiskDescription, RemediationOptions, IsApplicable, IsCompliant, Tags
